summary: Fixed the 4 RED tests in src/security/guard.test.ts by editing only guard.ts: enforced/ci guardOutput now blocks an incomplete engine gate (not just fail/needs-approval); formatGuardWarning no longer returns null for an incomplete decision with zero findings; securityFlowGate maps a stored latest report with gate incomplete, and any gate() error, to status fail with a constant leak-safe detail instead of pass/skipped. Refreshed stale no-op/fail-open comments. All 17 guard.test.ts tests pass; the required combined selection is 39 passed / 1 pre-existing failure (service.memo.test.ts:162, owned by T29, unmodified); eslint and typecheck are clean.

acceptance.criterion: AC6 (AFC-17): a found violation and an incomplete coverage state are visible at the same time; incomplete is never relabeled as pass.
acceptance.evidence: formatGuardWarning's findings branch already interpolates decision.gate (so incomplete + findings both show); new zero-findings branch surfaces 'incomplete' on its own. guard.test.ts parametrized incomplete-evidence tests (enforced/ci/advisory), 3/3 passed.

acceptance.criterion: AC8: no required failed/incomplete check is relabeled PASS; strict (enforced/ci) guards and the strict flow gate refuse incomplete evidence while advisory retains truthful incomplete diagnostics.
acceptance.evidence: guardOutput blocks on gate 'incomplete' in enforced/ci (allowed:false) while advisory keeps allowed:true with the true decision; securityFlowGate maps stored 'incomplete' reports and gate() errors to status 'fail' (not 'pass'/'skipped'). guard.test.ts: 'strict flow gate refuses incomplete security evidence' and the 3 parametrized tests all pass.

acceptance.criterion: Policy fold (policies.md): FAIL on an established threshold violation; INCOMPLETE when a required check is missing/skipped/unparsed/unfinished; strict CI accepts only PASS. The guard test file's 17 tests pass; no raw error, path or content leaks into reasons or details.
acceptance.evidence: src/security/guard.test.ts: 17/17 passed (raw .metaproject/data/gdctx/raw/2026-09-06T13-13-10-267Z_run.log). securityFlowGate's catch branch and formatGuardWarning's incomplete message are constant strings; no error.message, cwd or file path interpolated; tests assert JSON.stringify(result) does not contain the workspace root.
